title: Your Goods Could Travel Faster: Understanding the Expanded PM Gati Shakti Plan
description: The government is expanding its big plan to build better roads, railways, and other links across India. This plan, called PM Gati Shakti, aims to connect diff.

faq.a: "Gati" means speed or momentum, and "Shakti" means power or strength. So, it literally translates to "power of speed," referring to the aim of fast and powerful infrastructure development.

faq.q: When was the PM Gati Shakti plan launched?
faq.a: The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan was launched by the Prime Minister in October 2021.

faq.q: Which ministries are involved in PM Gati Shakti?
faq.a: It brings together 16 ministries, including Railways, Road Transport and Highways, Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Civil Aviation, Petroleum & Natural Gas, and Power, among others.
A digital platform with a Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping tool is used to monitor the progress of projects in real-time and identify any potential issues or bottlenecks.

The plan is primarily funded through existing budgetary allocations and additional government spending on infrastructure. There is no direct link to an increase in general taxes specifically for this plan.
